patch_description: The current candidate underperforms the earlier seed (0.67 vs 0.70) mainly because of the extra "rz_global" fine-tuning layer, which added a 6th distinct parameter without improving margins (worst_group_margin stayed the same while convergence doubled). Following the recommendation, I replace this weak addition with an orthogonal-interaction structure: insert a shared XX ring immediately after the existing ZZ ring (same neighbor topology, single shared parameter "xx_ring"), then drop the ineffective global RZ layer. Mixing ZZ and XX Ising couplings gives the entangling block access to a richer, non-commuting interaction structure that should better separate hard groups (improving worst-case margin) while keeping the parameter count unchanged (6 distinct params, same as before) and actually reducing gate redundancy compared to the failed global-RZ variant.
